title: Taurus: 4-hour soup. Gemini: cereal.
caption: Taurus wants nan's four-hour soup. Gemini wants cereal at midnight. Ask what their comfort meal is, and you'll know exactly what to bring on their worst day. Send this to someone having a bad week.
